- security/compliance callouts for your IT team

Proposed times (all listed in PDT; I included conversions below):
- Thu Mar 23 — 10:00 AM PDT (18:00 BST)
- Thu Mar 23 — 2:00 PM PDT (22:00 BST) — if you prefer later
- Fri Mar 24 — 9:00 AM PDT (17:00 BST)

If your IT/security folks want to join, please cc them and we’ll add a short pre-call to review network/firewall expectations. If none of those times work, tell me a couple windows and we’ll adapt.

Hi Ben — thanks for the quick intro and the one-pager. A couple of clarifying items from the IT side before we lock the demo: 

1) SOC 2 scope: do you cover enclave boundaries for hosted customers, or is that only for Private deployments? We’ll need to understand what’s in-scope for NovaPower.
2) Data residency: can you confirm EU residency options and export controls for logs/metrics?
3) Network requirements: we typically need a short list of ports/IPs and whether mutual TLS is required.

A pre-call with your SE sounds sensible. Wed Mar 22 at 13:00 BST works for a 20–25 minute check as long as Karthik can join. I’ve attached a brief intake spreadsheet (novapower-security-intake.xlsx) with the fields our procurement team needs filled; please populate the shaded rows before the pre-call if possible.

Thanks,
Maya Patel
IT Security Lead | NovaPower
it.ops@novapower.com
